sources.researchNote: The linked municipal PDF is the access carrier for a reproduction of the 1927 newspaper advertisement; it is not the repository of the original newspaper. The advertisement documents the opening of Château des Fleurs at Franklin Avenue and Cherokee Street.

media.title: Château des Fleurs — opening advertisement, 1927
media.description: Opening advertisement for the Hollywood apartment building documented as Bronisław Kaper’s residence in February 1936.
media.altText: Black-and-white 1927 advertisement for Château des Fleurs, with an architectural drawing of the French Norman Revival apartment building above decorative text.
media.publicCaption: Château des Fleurs, Franklin Avenue at Cherokee Street, Hollywood. Opening advertisement, 10 August 1927.
media.publicCreditLine: Los Angeles Times, 10 August 1927; reproduced by the City of Los Angeles Department of City Planning.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States: the advertisement was published in 1927. The displayed image is a crop from the reproduction in an official City of Los Angeles Department of City Planning report.

places.authorizedName: Château des Fleurs, 6626 Franklin Avenue, Hollywood, Los Angeles
places.publicNote: French Norman Revival apartment building completed in 1927 and designated Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument no. 799. Kaper’s 1 November 1935 immigration manifest records 6626 Franklin Avenue as his U.S. destination, and his Declaration of Intention dated 4 February 1936 records the same address as his residence.
